```{r}
required_pkgs <- c("MASS", "mclust", "dplyr")
optional_pkgs <- c("PLNmodels")

for(pkg in required_pkgs) {
  if(!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Please install package: ", pkg)
  }
}

has_plnmodels <- requireNamespace("PLNmodels", quietly = TRUE)
if(!has_plnmodels) {
  warning("Package PLNmodels is not installed. PLN mixture fits will return NA.")
}

library(MASS)
library(mclust)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(123)

simulate_poisson_mix <- function(n, pi, lambda) {
  G <- length(pi)
  p <- ncol(lambda)

  z <- sample(seq_len(G), size = n, replace = TRUE, prob = pi)
  X <- matrix(0L, nrow = n, ncol = p)

  for(i in seq_len(n)) {
    X[i, ] <- rpois(p, lambda = lambda[z[i], ])
  }

  colnames(X) <- paste0("Y", seq_len(p))
  list(X = X, z = z)
}

simulate_pln_mix <- function(n, pi, mu, Sigma) {
  G <- length(pi)
  p <- length(mu[[1L]])

  z <- sample(seq_len(G), size = n, replace = TRUE, prob = pi)
  X <- matrix(0L, nrow = n, ncol = p)

  for(i in seq_len(n)) {
    theta <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = 1L, mu = mu[[z[i]]], Sigma = Sigma[[z[i]]])
    lambda <- exp(theta)
    X[i, ] <- rpois(p, lambda = lambda)
  }

  colnames(X) <- paste0("Y", seq_len(p))
  list(X = X, z = z)
}

anscombe <- function(X) {
  2 * sqrt(X + 3/8)
}

fit_poisson_mixture_em <- function(X, G = 2, nstart = 10, maxit = 500, tol = 1e-8) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  n <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)

  best <- NULL
  best_loglik <- -Inf

  for(start in seq_len(nstart)) {
    km <- tryCatch(
      kmeans(anscombe(X), centers = G, nstart = 5),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if(is.null(km)) {
      z_start <- sample(seq_len(G), n, replace = TRUE)
    } else {
      z_start <- km$cluster
    }

    pi_g <- as.numeric(table(factor(z_start, levels = seq_len(G)))) / n
    pi_g[pi_g == 0] <- 1 / n
    pi_g <- pi_g / sum(pi_g)

    lambda <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = G, ncol = p)
    for(g in seq_len(G)) {
      idx <- which(z_start == g)
      if(length(idx) == 0) {
        lambda[g, ] <- colMeans(X) + runif(p, 0.01, 0.1)
      } else {
        lambda[g, ] <- colMeans(X[idx, , drop = FALSE]) + 1e-6
      }
    }

    old_loglik <- -Inf

    for(iter in seq_len(maxit)) {
      logdens <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = G)

      for(g in seq_len(G)) {
        logdens[, g] <- log(pi_g[g]) + rowSums(
          sapply(seq_len(p), function(j) dpois(X[, j], lambda = lambda[g, j], log = TRUE))
        )
      }

      maxlog <- apply(logdens, 1, max)
      dens_shifted <- exp(logdens - maxlog)
      denom <- rowSums(dens_shifted)
      tau <- dens_shifted / denom
      loglik <- sum(maxlog + log(denom))

      Nk <- colSums(tau)
      pi_g <- Nk / n

      for(g in seq_len(G)) {
        if(Nk[g] <= 1e-12) {
          lambda[g, ] <- colMeans(X) + 1e-6
        } else {
          lambda[g, ] <- colSums(tau[, g] * X) / Nk[g]
          lambda[g, ] <- pmax(lambda[g, ], 1e-8)
        }
      }

      if(abs(loglik - old_loglik) < tol) break
      old_loglik <- loglik
    }

    if(loglik > best_loglik) {
      best_loglik <- loglik
      best <- list(
        pi = pi_g,
        lambda = lambda,
        posterior = tau,
        classification = max.col(tau),
        loglik = loglik,
        iter = iter
      )
    }
  }

  best
}

fit_poisson_mixture <- function(X, G = 2) {
  tryCatch({
    fit <- fit_poisson_mixture_em(X, G = G)
    fit$classification
  }, error = function(e) rep(NA_integer_, nrow(X)))
}

fit_anscombe_mclust <- function(X, G = 2) {
  tryCatch({
    fit <- mclust::Mclust(anscombe(as.matrix(X)), G = G)
    fit$classification
  }, error = function(e) rep(NA_integer_, nrow(X)))
}

fit_pln_mixture <- function(X, G = 2) {
  if(!has_plnmodels) return(rep(NA_integer_, nrow(X)))

  tryCatch({
    count_df <- as.data.frame(X)

    dat <- PLNmodels::prepare_data(
      counts = count_df,
      covariates = matrix(1, nrow = nrow(count_df), ncol = 1)
    )

    fit <- PLNmodels::PLNmixture(
      Abundance ~ 1,
      data = dat,
      clusters = G
    )

    membership <- fit$models[[1]]$memberships

    if(is.matrix(membership)) {
      max.col(membership)
    } else {
      as.integer(membership)
    }
  }, error = function(e) rep(NA_integer_, nrow(X)))
}

safe_ari <- function(true_z, pred_z) {
  if(length(pred_z) != length(true_z) || all(is.na(pred_z))) return(NA_real_)
  mclust::adjustedRandIndex(true_z, pred_z)
}

evaluate_one_dataset <- function(X, z_true, G = 2, data_generating_model, n, rep) {
  methods <- list(
    "Poisson mixture EM" = fit_poisson_mixture,
    "PLN mixture" = fit_pln_mixture,
    "Anscombe + Mclust" = fit_anscombe_mclust
  )

  out <- lapply(names(methods), function(method_name) {
    tm <- system.time({
      pred <- methods[[method_name]](X, G = G)
    })

    data.frame(
      data_generating_model = data_generating_model,
      n = n,
      rep = rep,
      method = method_name,
      ARI = safe_ari(z_true, pred),
      runtime_seconds = as.numeric(tm["elapsed"]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  bind_rows(out)
}

G_true <- 2
p_true <- 3
pi_true <- c(0.4, 0.6)

lambda_poisson <- rbind(
  c(5, 2, 10),
  c(1, 7, 3)
)
colnames(lambda_poisson) <- paste0("Y", seq_len(p_true))
rownames(lambda_poisson) <- paste0("Cluster", seq_len(G_true))

mu_pln <- list(
  c(log(5), log(2), log(10)),
  c(log(1), log(7), log(3))
)

Sigma_pln <- list(
  matrix(
    c(0.3, 0.1, 0.05,
      0.1, 0.2, 0.05,
      0.05, 0.05, 0.4),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  ),
  matrix(
    c(0.2, 0.05, 0.02,
      0.05, 0.3, 0.01,
      0.02, 0.01, 0.25),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
)

set.seed(123)
study1_dataset <- simulate_poisson_mix(
  n = 500,
  pi = pi_true,
  lambda = lambda_poisson
)
study1_df <- data.frame(
  id = seq_len(nrow(study1_dataset$X)),
  true_cluster = study1_dataset$z,
  study1_dataset$X
)
write.csv(study1_df, "sim_study1_poisson_mixture.csv", row.names = FALSE)

set.seed(123)
study2_dataset <- simulate_pln_mix(
  n = 500,
  pi = pi_true,
  mu = mu_pln,
  Sigma = Sigma_pln
)
study2_df <- data.frame(
  id = seq_len(nrow(study2_dataset$X)),
  true_cluster = study2_dataset$z,
  study2_dataset$X
)
write.csv(study2_df, "sim_study2_pln_mixture.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Datasets saved:\n")
cat("1. sim_study1_poisson_mixture.csv: generated from independent Poisson mixture\n")
cat("2. sim_study2_pln_mixture.csv: generated from Poisson-lognormal mixture\n\n")

design <- expand.grid(
  n = c(100, 250, 500),
  rep = 1:20
)

all_results <- vector("list", 2 * nrow(design))
k <- 1

for(i in seq_len(nrow(design))) {
  n_current <- design$n[i]
  rep_current <- design$rep[i]

  cat("Running Simulation Study 1:", i, "of", nrow(design), "\n")
  set.seed(10000 + i)
  sim1 <- simulate_poisson_mix(
    n = n_current,
    pi = pi_true,
    lambda = lambda_poisson
  )

  all_results[[k]] <- evaluate_one_dataset(
    X = sim1$X,
    z_true = sim1$z,
    G = G_true,
    data_generating_model = "Independent Poisson mixture",
    n = n_current,
    rep = rep_current
  )
  k <- k + 1

  cat("Running Simulation Study 2:", i, "of", nrow(design), "\n")
  set.seed(20000 + i)
  sim2 <- simulate_pln_mix(
    n = n_current,
    pi = pi_true,
    mu = mu_pln,
    Sigma = Sigma_pln
  )

  all_results[[k]] <- evaluate_one_dataset(
    X = sim2$X,
    z_true = sim2$z,
    G = G_true,
    data_generating_model = "Poisson-lognormal mixture",
    n = n_current,
    rep = rep_current
  )
  k <- k + 1
}

results_df <- bind_rows(all_results)

summary_results <- results_df %>%
  group_by(data_generating_model, n, method) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_ARI = mean(ARI, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ARI = sd(ARI, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_runtime_seconds = mean(runtime_seconds, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_runtime_seconds = sd(runtime_seconds, na.rm = TRUE),
    failures = sum(is.na(ARI)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(results_df, "simulation_results_all.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(summary_results, "simulation_summary_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(summary_results)

if(requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(ggplot2)

  p1 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = factor(n), y = ARI, fill = method)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_wrap(~ data_generating_model) +
    labs(
      x = "Sample size",
      y = "Adjusted Rand Index",
      title = "Clustering performance by data-generating model"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  p2 <- ggplot(results_df, aes(x = factor(n), y = runtime_seconds, fill = method)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    facet_wrap(~ data_generating_model) +
    labs(
      x = "Sample size",
      y = "Runtime in seconds",
      title = "Runtime by data-generating model"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p1)
  print(p2)
}
```
